title: Virus Purification Protocol for Ehv-163 and Other Viruses
author: Elena Yakubovskaya
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcpvivn6
materials: Prepare OptiPrep solutions using F/2-Si media or 150mM NaCl, 20mM HEPES pH 8.0 buffer. 1mM EDTA buffer as the diluent. For many viruses, a gradient from 20%- 50% OptiPrep will provide a good range for separation, but very dense or light viruses may require adjustment. For EhV-163 virus, we used 20%, 25%, 30%, 35%, 40% and 50% v/v OptiPrep solutions (OptiPrep is sold as a 60% solution).

steps.title: Concentrate Virus Lysate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the lysate 50 times using tangential flow filtration to decrease the volume.

substeps.instruction: Use a Vivaflow 50 cartridge (100 KDa MWCO).
For EhV-163, target a final volume of 50 ml and a final concentration of ~7 x 10^9 EhV/ml.

steps.title: Prepare Density Gradient
steps.instruction: Prepare a 6-step gradient in open-toped ultracentrifuge tubes using a syringe and pipetting needle, adding the least dense solution first.

substeps.instruction: Add 1ml 20% solution
Add 2ml 25% solution
Add 2ml 30% solution
Add 2ml 35% solution
Add 2ml 40% solution
Add 1ml 50% solution
Allow the gradient to blend for 2 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge Virus Concentrate
steps.instruction: Overlay the gradient with virus concentrate and centrifuge to separate the virus.

substeps.instruction: Carefully overlay the gradient with virus concentrate (e.g., 2-mL concentrated virus for a 10-mL gradient).
Centrifuge using an SW-41 ultracentrifuge rotor at 26,000 rpm (100,000g) for 4h (or overnight).
Decelerate the rotor using a slow deceleration program below 4000 rpm or turn off the brake below 4000 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest Virus Bands
steps.instruction: Identify and collect the virus bands from the density gradient.

substeps.instruction: Locate visible virus bands using a regular flashlight.
Harvest a single band using a side or bottom puncture with a needle.

steps.title: Remove Iodixanol via Dialysis
steps.instruction: Remove iodixanol from the Ehv-163 sample using dialysis.

substeps.instruction: Perform 3x dialysis against 1L of 150mM NaCl, 20mM HEPES pH 8.0, 1mM EDTA buffer.
Use Float-A-Lyzer G2 with a 100kD cut off dialysis membrane.

steps.title: Final Purification and Storage
steps.instruction: Perform final purification of EhV-163 to remove remaining traces of iodixanol and store the sample.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate 3 ml of CaptoCore 700 resin with 10ml of 150mM NaCl, 20mM HEPES pH 8.0, 1mM EDTA buffer.
Purify EhV-163 on the Capto Core 700 resin using either the in batch or column method.
Aliquot the purified virus sample.
Store the virus sample at 4°C in the dark.
